meta.title: Wave Insight waveforms
meta.description: Gives the AI waveform tools for VCD, FST and GHW dumps and shows a live waveform panel in the right sidebar as signals and the time range change. Start with load_waveform(path), then use find_signals, add_signals, set_time_range, set_cursors, get_changes and list_waveform. Calling a tool opens the Wave Insight tab; the panel follows each later tool call. The Windows helper binary is bundled; other platforms need WAVE_DSH_BRIDGE or a local cargo build of dsh-bridge.
